sources.title: Qwen3.6-27B official model card
sources.evidence: Identifies the open checkpoint, nominal 27B language model, hybrid attention layout, native context, image/video examples, thinking modes, tool calling, and visual/document/agent evaluations. Reopened October 27: Model Overview still lists 27B specifically under Language Model and no separately defined active count.

sources.title: Qwen3.6-27B checkpoint configuration
sources.evidence: Qwen3_5ForConditionalGeneration includes a 64-layer dense text stack with alternating linear/full attention, a 27-layer vision encoder and one MTP layer; max_position_embeddings is 262144. Reopened October 27: the same dense text/vision/MTP structure remains; the config does not define an active-parameter convention.

sources.title: Official checkpoint tensor index and referenced safetensors headers
sources.evidence: Read headers of all 15 referenced shards by HTTP Range, multiplied each tensor shape, and matched all 1199 tensor names against this index. Exact BF16 count: 27781427952; text decoder including embeddings and LM head 26895998464, vision 460730096, MTP 424699392. Index byte total is 55562855904. October 27 re-audit reopened the index and confirmed its unchanged 55562855904-byte total; the prior validated tensor/component counts are retained without recounting or downloading shards.

sources.title: Hugging Face metadata for the official Qwen checkpoint
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27: safetensors metadata still reports 27781427952 BF16 parameters at revision 6a9e13bd6fc8f0983b9b99948120bc37f49c13e9. This independently reconfirms the exact full-checkpoint total. Repository creation is April 21, 2026, which is not public-release evidence.

sources.evidence: Former Qwen3.6 URL redirects here. The retained news entry explicitly announces Qwen3.6-27B availability on April 22, 2026; repository identifies the Qwen team as part of Alibaba Group.

sources.title: Qwen3.6-27B: Flagship-Level Coding in a 27B Dense Model
sources.evidence: Indexed official announcement is dated April 22, 2026 and identifies a dense multimodal open-weight model supporting thinking and non-thinking. Direct page extraction returned no body; indexed text is corroborated by the official repository news and model card.

sources.title: Later official Qwen3.8-27B model card and Qwen3.6-27B comparison tables
sources.evidence: Checked October 27 for a later activated-parameter disclosure. Text and vision-language benchmark tables explicitly include Qwen3.6-27B but contain no total/activated parameter row or column. No active count for Qwen3.6-27B is supplied.

sources.title: Alibaba Cloud publication of Qwen3.6-27B launch announcement
sources.evidence: Directly read October 27. Repeats Qwen's dense 27-billion-parameter multimodal specification and identifies the same open weights and API model. Explicit active counts in the text apply to the comparison MoE models, not Qwen3.6-27B; no separate active count for this dense model is stated.

sources.title: Current Alibaba Cloud Model Studio Qwen3.6-27B specification
sources.evidence: October 27 indexed official page describes the Qwen3.6 27B native vision-language dense model as building on Qwen3.5-27B. Its displayed capabilities, context, pricing and rate-limit tables do not disclose active parameters. Direct open exceeded the extraction size limit; only indexed official text was available.

patch.notes: The full BF16 checkpoint contains 27.781427952B parameters: 26.895998464B text decoder including embeddings and LM head, 0.460730096B vision, and 0.424699392B MTP. Qwen advertises a nominal 27B language model. Active parameters are not separately disclosed. Dense FFNs coexist with hybrid linear/full attention.

summary: October 27 parameter re-audit reconfirmed the exact 27.781427952B checkpoint total using current repository metadata and retained the prior verified decoder/vision/MTP components. Reopened exact primary evidence and checked the current Model Studio specification, Alibaba launch publication and later Qwen3.8-27B comparison tables; no separate active count was found. Preserve active_parameters_b=null and all unrelated audit findings.
